work.description: CCLXXX Civitatis titulum: whole five-clause Spello restoration brief, complete ancient and episcopal history,1772 diocesan transfer, civic and ecclesiastical institutions, CollegiumFelix and1827 norm/petition, city grant with Foligno jurisdiction and civil-government reservations, full validation, derogation and datum LF55462–55465. Exact XML leaves419–420 normal substantive order. Own detached date/proem labels LF55258–55265 at leaf419 y1538–1903 accompany own heading/proem at y1423 onward; they are retained before own title in original emitted order and excluded from prior SantElpidio act. These are marginal apparatus, not a reversed substantive body. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
